description: This PHP source file generates a web page displaying software information about a network gateway device, including version, firmware name, model, and WAN type-specific details. It also includes several external PHP includes for header, footer, utility, navigation, and user bar components.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value associated with a specific device parameter, used to fetch device information such as software version, firmware name, and model.

methods.name: get_wan_type
methods.description: Determines the type of WAN connection (e.g., EPON, DSL) to customize displayed information accordingly.
